observed_statement.precision: Rounded to 0.1 thousand km2; undated agency reference page

role: Coarse independent size reference for screening whether a scoped unit approaches Kemerovo Oblast scale; not a legal boundary or exact cadastral area.
publisher: Main Directorate of the Ministry of Emergency Situations of Russia for Kemerovo Oblast–Kuzbass
retention: The web page bytes are not redistributed; restoration URL, retrieval date, exact retrieved-page SHA-256 and observed statement are retained.
license: Reuse terms for the page were not established.
limits: The page gives a rounded region-wide reference, not per-unit areas or legal boundary geometry.
The page does not state an observation date; the quoted area is not an exact denominator for completeness or coverage.
Area sums do not test polygon union, overlap, gaps, adjacency, or legal correspondence.
